name: tune_heads
description: Which models to tune.

name: tune_predict_gpu
description: Use the GPU for the re-prediction pass (the ONNX one, not training).

name: tune_predict_sessions
description: ONNX Runtime sessions for the re-prediction pass; 0 = default.

name: tune_keep_free_cysteine_offset
description: Keep DIALibGen's free-cysteine RT offset when re-predicting with a TUNED RT model. Off by default: that offset was fitted against the STOCK model, and a model tuned on this run's own identifications has had the chance to learn the effect itself -- applying both counts it twice.

name: filter:q_value
description: Precursor Q.Value threshold

name: filter:min_charge
description: CCS only: lowest precursor charge used (RT collapses all charges). z1 is censored at the mobility ramp top on timsTOF

name: filter:allow_z1
description: CCS: permit filter:min_charge 1 (censored observations enter training)

name: filter:rt_spread_max
description: Drop a sequence whose charge states' RTs span more than this (minutes)

name: filter:rt_max_minutes
description: rt_norm denominator; 0 = the run's maximum observed RT

name: cohort:train_size
description: Training units (sequences for rt, sequence x charge for ccs); 0 = full pool

name: cohort:train_frac
description: Alternative to train_size: fraction of the pool

name: cohort:full_fit
description: Train on EVERY unit of the run, the test and validation cohorts included: the closest fit the data allows. val and TEST are then in-sample; judge this mode by searching a DIFFERENT run with the result, never by its own numbers

name: cohort:no_inner_val
description: No inner validation cohort: its units rejoin the pool and checkpoints are selected on TEST, which is then no longer a held-out number

name: train:epochs
description: Horizon of the cosine schedule (and the maximum epochs)

name: train:warmup
description: Linear warmup epochs

name: train:lr
description: Peak learning rate (Adam)

name: train:batch_size
description: Batch size within a length group

name: stop:eval_every
description: Validate every n epochs

name: stop:min_epochs
description: Never stop before this epoch

name: stop:patience
description: Stop after this many epochs without progress (never before max(min_epochs, warmup))

name: stop:rel_tol
description: Progress = the selection metric beats the anchor by this fraction

name: stop:abs_tol
description: Progress = beats the anchor by this absolute amount (0 = use rel_tol)

name: stop:max_seconds
description: Wall-clock budget per head, checked at epoch boundaries; final evaluation/export may exceed it (0 = none)

name: stop:select
description: Selection metric on the validation cohort

name: machine:device
description: cpu or cuda[:N]

name: machine:threads
description: CPU threads used for training

name: machine:no_cudnn
description: CUDA: do not use cuDNN (needed when only its loader shim is installed, as in pytorch.org's libtorch zips); slower

name: machine:seed
description: Seed for the training subsample and batch order
